review.title: Keep Club minimal feedback placement review (02/03)

rulings: Edit remains one tap from Study and Browse
2026-08-24: Theme belongs in Settings and is removed from shelf screens
recordedOnly: Imported card content remains local and absent from automatic report context

review.toolingDeviation: Workflow was unavailable; independent read-only collaboration waves and main-loop Chromium probes were used against a pinned worktree.

proposal02.placement: Replace the existing 48x48 shelf Theme control with Help in .shelf-mark
proposal02.coldShelf: Show one 48x48 visual ? in the former Theme slot; keep Share completely unchanged.
proposal02.courseOverlay: Show the same 48x48 ? immediately before Close, preserving the existing two-control header geometry.
proposal02.owner: munin.js or a shell module loaded by it
proposal02.modalRule: Replace the overlay shelf or use an internal view; never stack aria-modal siblings.

proposal03.placement: Immediately before Close in the sticky existing-card Edit sheet bar
proposal03.accessibleName: Report a problem with this card
proposal03.visibility: existing card only; hidden for New card
proposal03.navigation: Internal card-sheet feedback subview; preserve textareas and card identity; visible Back, Escape, and browser/Android Back return to Edit first.
proposal03.privacy: Attach only a safe built-in card reference. Imported cards attach no identifier or content.
proposal03.studyTradeoff: No permanent Study-header icon in the minimal pass; active non-card Study issues remain uncovered.

verdicts.claim: The best shelf option converts Share to an icon and pairs it with ?.
verdicts.evidence: Keeping the existing Share pill plus ? preserves the stateful share labels and has the same reachable-state height with no overflow.

failureScenario.input: Replace the stateful Share pill with a fixed 48px glyph button
failureScenario.wrongOutput: shareShelf replaces the glyph with shared/copied/try again text that overflows, then restores literal share text instead of the icon

verification.mainLoopHandRepro: Counterexample confirmed: unchanged Share plus ? stays 48px high with no overflow

verdicts.claim: Adding a shelf-header ? while retaining Theme is not viable in the current 320px overlay/Biggest layout.
verdicts.evidence: Independent probes reproduced 7-8px overflow for Theme + Help + Close. The 2026-08-24 ruling removes Theme; Help + Close reuses the baseline geometry with zero overflow.

failureScenario.input: Insert a 48px Help target without removing Theme
failureScenario.wrongOutput: The 280px header scroll width grows to 287-288px and runs into right padding

verification.mainLoopHandRepro: Amended replacement variant verified: Help x194-242, Close x252-300, zero overflow

verdicts.claim: A visually tiny glyph still needs a 44-48px target, visible focus, and explicit accessible name.
verdicts.evidence: Keep Club's target convention is 48px; injected controls exposed visible focus and predictable keyboard order.

failureScenario.wrongOutput: The target is too small and announces only an ambiguous question mark

verdicts.evidence: How and footer were below the first viewport, but absolute positioning does not inherently break DOM focus order.

failureScenario.input: Place Help in collapsed How, footer, or an unspecified absolute corner
failureScenario.wrongOutput: How/footer are offscreen, but no universal wrong output was proven for every possible corner implementation

verification.independentVerifier: REFUTED as a categorical combined claim
verification.mainLoopHandRepro: How/footer reachability confirmed; blanket corner failure not confirmed

verdicts.claim: The cold-shelf entry cannot be implemented only in app.js.
verdicts.evidence: munin.js renders the cold shelf before app.js loads.

failureScenario.state: Fresh profile with no selected course
failureScenario.input: Implement shelf Help only in app.js
failureScenario.wrongOutput: The shelf renders without the Help markup or handler because app.js is not loaded

verification.mainLoopHandRepro: VERIFIED: fresh cold shelf loaded munin.js and related shell scripts, not app.js

verdicts.claim: A 48px ? immediately before Close is the least intrusive existing-card Edit placement and fits 320x568/Biggest.
verdicts.evidence: The bar remained 316x74px without overflow; Help and Close had 48px targets and 8px gaps.

failureScenario.wrongOutput: Candidate would fail if it overflowed, grew the sticky bar, or appeared for New card; none occurred when visibility was conditional

verification.mainLoopHandRepro: VERIFIED portrait and short-landscape geometry; mockup New-card state hides ?

verdicts.claim: Edit feedback must use an internal subview and preserve dirty values across Back/Escape.
verdicts.evidence: closeCardSheet clears cardSheet and both textareas; the live Close/reopen probe lost the dirty sentinel.

failureScenario.state: Dirty Question and Answer in Edit
failureScenario.input: Open feedback, then press visible Back, Escape, or browser/Android Back
failureScenario.wrongOutput: Current closeCardSheet path clears the edit and leaves the sheet instead of returning to Edit

verification.mainLoopHandRepro: VERIFIED dirty loss in current close/reopen path; mockup preserves the sentinel for all three return mechanisms

verdicts.claim: Form-footer and per-Browse-row report controls are inferior.
verdicts.evidence: At Biggest, the form action began below the 568px viewport; Browse exposed 40 repeated Edit targets and a 58px gutter before any report control.

failureScenario.input: Put Report in the form footer or beside every row Edit
failureScenario.wrongOutput: Footer starts below the viewport; per-row cluster grows to 109px and overlaps or forces substantially narrower questions

verification.mainLoopHandRepro: VERIFIED footer position and Browse repetition/gutter

verdicts.claim: Settings already covers active non-card Study problems, so a Study icon has no coverage value.
verdicts.evidence: Study has no Settings control; leaving clears the active session. Omitting the icon is an accepted minimalism tradeoff, not equivalent coverage.

failureScenario.state: Active Study queue with a non-card bug
failureScenario.input: Try to reach generic feedback through Settings
failureScenario.wrongOutput: No Settings control exists; leaving Study clears the session before the user can report

verification.mainLoopHandRepro: Coverage gap confirmed; omission retained only as an explicit scope tradeoff

verdicts.claim: The Edit ? needs an explicit card-report name and must precede Close in DOM and visual order.
verdicts.evidence: This preserves an edge-most Close control, predictable Report -> Close -> form traversal, and a meaningful accessible name.

failureScenario.state: Keyboard or screen-reader use in Edit
failureScenario.input: Use an unnamed ? or append it after Close
failureScenario.wrongOutput: The action is announced ambiguously and Close stops being the familiar edge-most dismissal control

verification.mainLoopHandRepro: VERIFIED 48px targets, 8px gap, visible focus, explicit name, and Report -> Close -> form order

additionalFinding.claim: Opening feedback from the already-modal course shelf overlay must not stack another modal.

failureScenario.state: Course overlay open with its focus/Escape trap active
failureScenario.input: Stack and focus a sibling aria-modal feedback dialog, then press Escape
failureScenario.wrongOutput: The shelf handler removes the shelf and leaves the sibling feedback modal orphaned

verification.mainLoopHandRepro: VERIFIED by runtime sibling-dialog injection: two modals before Escape, orphan feedback modal after Escape

amendments.ruling: Theme already lives in Settings and is removed from the shelf screens.
amendments.effect: Proposal 02 moves Help from the shelf intro row into the vacated Theme slot; the prior additive header-overflow finding no longer applies to the surviving design.
